tools.name: search_courses
tools.description: Search for a named course or filter the directory by city/state, access, and holes. For a trip near a place, station, address, or ZIP, call find_nearby_courses FIRST; do not put the place name in query (query searches course names). You may also pass location here for a proximity search. Returns can

tools.name: get_course
tools.description: Get full details for a specific golf course by a returned Stymie URL or slug. Returns name, location, type, holes, architect, year built, amenities, public contact info, recorded closure status, and published tee ratings. A recorded open flag is not a live confirmation of seasonal opening or tee-tim

tools.name: get_scorecard
tools.description: Get the full scorecard for a golf course: all tee sets with hole-by-hole par, yardage, stroke index, and front/back nine ratings. Available for thousands of courses with scorecard data.

tools.name: get_architect
tools.description: Get details about a golf course architect: bio, Wikipedia image, birth/death years, nationality, and all courses they designed grouped by state. Provide either the architect name or URL slug.

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: Rank courses in a state using published tee data: hardest uses highest slope, easiest uses lowest slope among public/municipal courses, and longest uses maximum yardage. Returns each course name, access type, measured value and canonical Stymie URL. Link each recommended course using its returned UR

tools.name: search_tee_times
tools.description: Get booking information for a course already returned by search_courses or find_nearby_courses. Returns its Stymie course-page link, where the golfer can find the official website or phone, plus an optional early-access alerts page. This legacy search_tee_times tool does not search live inventory: s

tools.name: search_stymie
tools.description: Search Stymie across golf courses, current equipment, architects, and major site tools. Use this first when the user does not specify which Stymie collection they need.

tools.name: search_equipment
tools.description: Search current golf balls, drivers, putters, rangefinders, and launch monitors. Returns official Stymie detail URLs, images, MSRP, and stated best-for guidance when published.

tools.name: find_nearby_courses
tools.description: START HERE to plan golf near a place, transit station, address, or US ZIP: pass the place text as location, plus access (public/private/all) and holes (9/18) if known. Coordinates are optional; no slug knowledge is needed. Resolves the location and returns its labeled center and a nearest-first rank

tools.name: build_golf_trip
tools.description: AFTER find_nearby_courses, pass its center latitude/longitude, access and holes preferences, and number_of_courses to make a 1-4 course shortlist. You can also start directly with a plain-language location (place, station, address, or US ZIP). Optional tee yardage and slope ranges rank matching tees

tools.name: get_deals
tools.description: Get golf-equipment sale offers that were marked in stock when checked within the last 48 hours, with a checked price below list price. Returns each product’s canonical Stymie detail URL, merchant offer URL, price, savings and checked_at time. Link every recommended product to its returned Stymie URL

tools.name: get_data_coverage
tools.description: Return a live count of Stymie course, scorecard, logo, architect, equipment, and current-deal coverage. Use this instead of quoting hardcoded catalog sizes.
